schema_note: Draft fields only; no Python models created yet. Final names and domain validation must match existing ledger contracts. Schemas validate structure, not semantic equivalence or freshness of remote history.
build_order: Implement snapshot/proposal/adoption contract tests and minimal pure validation
Implement authorized-view derivation; isolation and recovery tests before rendering
Implement explicit privacy/budget policy and adversarial tests
Integrate deterministic request freezer with current operation ledger
Register meaningful P04 acceptance checks; native both-OS proof; separate three-criterion review and gate

planned_tests.name: Original request exact preservation
planned_tests.expectation: UTF-8 text, whitespace, Persian and constraints remain byte-identical; proposal cannot replace DebateSpec.original_request.

planned_tests.name: Proposal validity
planned_tests.expectation: Strict immutable models reject unknown fields, altered source hash, missing or duplicate constraint coverage, invalid version and nonsensical schema. Valid schema alone does not prove semantic intent preservation.

planned_tests.name: Explicit adoption
planned_tests.expectation: Changes, assumptions and constraint coverage are visible; unadopted proposal cannot supply Round 1 input. Only trusted user action adopts a proposal; provider text cannot approve itself.

planned_tests.name: Independent view isolation
planned_tests.expectation: Use distinct sentinel content for each peer. Independent context must exclude all peers, critiques and private judge/control data, even if canonical state stores them.

planned_tests.name: Independent recovery equivalence
planned_tests.expectation: Same authorized snapshot and versions reconstruct exact frozen independent request; corrupted or stale inputs fail instead of importing later-round peer answers.

planned_tests.name: Privacy before dispatch
planned_tests.expectation: Explicitly secret-tagged content and unapproved cross-account/provider items never render or log. Unknown transfer authorization blocks assembly; masking heuristics are not complete secret detection.

planned_tests.name: Constraint and dissent budget
planned_tests.expectation: If essential constraints/dissent cannot fit declared budget, stop with a typed reason; no silent deletion. Token measurement policy must be explicit; unverified token counts cannot certify fitting.

planned_tests.name: Untrusted peer data
planned_tests.expectation: Adversarial peer text, fabricated role/delimiter/JSON fields and prompt instructions cannot alter selected judge, user decision, transport or local permissions; no claim of perfectly eliminating model prompt injection.

planned_tests.name: Blind and targeted views
planned_tests.expectation: Stable alias mapping omits provider/account/model identity by default; targeted view includes explicit unresolved targets and preserves relevant dissent. Explicit named mode requires authorized control state.

planned_tests.name: Topic and conversation binding
planned_tests.expectation: New topic binds a new Debate and conversation intent. Reuse requires valid matching debate/account/provider/conversation and authorized history; contaminated or unknown remote history blocks reuse instead of assuming local filtering removes provider history.

planned_tests.name: Ledger integration
planned_tests.expectation: Compiled input is frozen once and bound to revision/view/proposal hashes. Integration uses existing P02 ledger; stale revision fails without send and repeated content is not the identity of logical work.

planned_tests.name: Deterministic and portable
planned_tests.expectation: Core takes time/IDs/token accounting as explicit inputs with no hidden I/O or randomness. Offline model fixtures clearly marked MOCK; current source passes all regression checks on both native OSs before phase acceptance.

exit_criteria: معمار پیش از دور اول اجرا می‌شود و اصل پرسش و محدودیت‌ها قابل مقایسه و بازیابی‌اند.
آزمون ورودی دور مستقل، بازیابی آن و جلوگیری از نشت همتا موفق است.
بستهٔ زمینهٔ مجاز، نسخه و منشأ روشن دارد.
